title: a redefinition of a feature that does not exist is reported
note: FIXED 2026-09-03 (I4). `w` is not a member of `Base` (that is `wheel`). The rule used to accept any reference the bundled library could match by LAST SEGMENT, and the library has a function parameter named `w` (`VectorFunctions::+::w`), so this dangling redefinition passed validation silently. A library FEATURE no longer counts as the answer to a user reference; a bare library DEFINITION (`:> Part`) still does.
